summary: No installer-side threat identified in tailwind-motionkit@1.0.3
details: Review of tailwind-motionkit@1.0.3 surfaced no evidence of exfiltration, install-time remote code execution, silent relay, credential distribution, backdoor, or self-propagation. No lifecycle hooks fetching or executing remote content, no reads of installer secret paths, and no hardcoded attacker network destinations were observed in the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
